In the image the upper half of the breadboard is labelled f-j and the lower half a-e. I mapped these to the catalogue's banks: upper half = 'b' (rows f-j), lower half = 't' (rows a-e).
Breadboard holes are read from the image. Blue wire at 3b.f, resistor 3b.g to 6b.g, LED anode at 6b.h, LED cathode at 8b.h, black GND wire at 8b.g.
The potentiometer straddles the centre gap. Its wiper (SIG) is in column 23 of the upper half, with the yellow wire from A0 at 23b.g. Its outer legs are in columns 22 and 24 of the lower half.

The pot's left leg (22t.e) goes to GND by the black wire and its right leg (24t.e) goes to 5V by the red wire, as the image shows. The pot is symmetric between GND and VCC, so swapping them would not matter electrically.
The LED's long leg (anode) is on the resistor side, as the text says. The resistor sits between pin 9 and the anode, and the cathode goes to GND.
The two black wires use different Uno GND pins: GND.1 on the power header for the pot, and GND.2 on the digital header (next to AREF) for the LED.
